text:
Gold Price in 1985
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1985, the LBMA gold price rose 6.6% between 1985-01-31 ($307) and 1985-12-30 ($327). The highest sampled price was $333 in August and the lowest was $288 in February. The mean of these observations was $320. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
